title: Silent Meeting
subtitle: Silence is golden—we'd do well to possess this virtue.

trails.title: A Refresher of the Essentials
trails.description: The island's precepts must be memorized. When entering and leaving the assembly hall, from "which side do you enter, and on which side do you leave"?

items.text: Silent Meeting

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Before you enter the great hall, please place your right palm on the stone and swear to it solemnly.
The girl closes her eyes and begins an emphatic prayer.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I wish to be baptized in the water of Gnosis, and be rid of the long darkness of ignorance.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I ask my tongue to be taken, for it has spoken mindless words, and I shall stay silent for the truth.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I choose to leave the fragments of Matters behind me, and enter the great hall of Forms as clean as a newborn.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I swear to let matter stay in the world of Matter, and form in the world of Forms.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I swear to reveal no secrets. Or my heart shall be taken by the vulture, my body consumed in flames, my soul trapped in the endless wheel of birth.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Now. Knock three times on the stone. Put on these ceremonial dresses. That'd be all.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Remember to enter the hall from the right and leave from the left.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: You are the humblest audience here, hence not allowed to speak. Please stay quiet and keep the secrets you heard at heart.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: I will arrange your meeting with 6 after this.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No problem. Ms. Sophia, could you give us some privacy?

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Please, enjoy. I have nothing more to say.
She walks away indifferently, as if none of them actually existed before her.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Vertin, are we really going to do this? That oath we have to make to enter the hall sounds vicious.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: To stay quiet and keep the secrets.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It's similar to the training we once received. I can go inside on behalf of Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, I'll come with you, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I can't sense any sign of arcane skill on this stone. The oath is more of a formality than a curse.

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: The warning is lifted, then?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But when Sophia repaired the floor in front of us with her arcane skill ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There's no fluctuation of arcane power, either. I can't even sense the slightest signs.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's either a kind of arcane skills we're not able to detect ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Or, the moment we stepped onto this island ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We've been trapped in a tremendous ritual.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: That's to say, any arcanum used on this island is only a part of this giant flow.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We don't know where this flow is leading us. We know nothing about it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It's too perilous, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I know, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But as long as we obey their rules, we won't get into other trouble.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The doctrine of the Apeiron is to live in solitude and seek nothing but the truth. In fact, they've never been aggressive towards us.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Heh heh, I think of this differently.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Think. The pure-blood arcanist community, the unknown arcanum power, and the obsession with certain knowledge or identity ... sound familiar?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yet we haven't spotted any traces of the Manus here.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Tsk, Manus Vindictae is like the rat living in the gutter. I don't think they will let go such a favorable chance.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Which means we need to find out the truth.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I believe in Timekeeper.
Lilya shakes her hands.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I have zero interest in this meeting. I'll stay outside to keep a lookout. Take care.
There is no time to hesitate.
The door already lies before them.
Hands on hands, and recite the vows in mind.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I wish to be baptized in the water of Gnosis, and be rid of the long darkness of ignorance.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I ask my tongue to be taken, for it has spoken mindless words, and I shall stay silent for the truth.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I choose to leave the fragments of Matters behind me, and enter the great hall of Forms as clean as a newborn.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I swear to let matter stay in the world of Matter, and form in the world of Forms.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... I swear to reveal no secrets ...

items.speaker: Vertin&Sonetto
items.text: .... Or my heart shall be taken by the vulture, my body consumed in flames, my soul trapped in the endless wheel of birth.
The Hall of Apeiron
All seats in the hall have been taken.
Fellow brothers, sisters. Our quest for Gnosis has suffered three unprecedented crises.
First was the discovery of irrational numbers, and then the creation of imaginary numbers. Last was the loss of the grand unification of different lineages.
The truth was buried, and history was rewritten.
But the Emanation is not a crisis. Instead, it's our last salvation.
The supreme existence has once again shown itself to us. The door to the everlasting transcendent world of Forms has opened once again!
As pneuma pours down, things are rewound to the world of light. Everything in the world of Matter breaks into pieces, for they are as delicate as a petal before it.
We, who have the honor to witness the Emanation of pneuma, have the privilege to survive the turning of the wheel of birth.
Because we know the truth!
Our survival is destined. It is the beginning of a mission to bring the unseen truth into this world!
His audience response with a round of applause. But nobody says a word.
Thank you.
The speaker bows in thanks and gestures towards the hall.
The next orator is 37, our smallest irregular prime and the brightest star of Hermes!
The applause stops.
A moment of silent reverence passes, a dedication to truth.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: The Emanation in 1929 only lasted for two days.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: All methods to calculate the pneuma Emanation failed. We found no pattern in the occurrence of time reversal.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: All our efforts in the past four years have gone completely wasted.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: That's the end of my speech.
Silence.
Long and dead silence.
Abruptly, someone starts to clap.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Huh!!
Order comes first, and opinion comes second.
The mission matters the most.
This is what she has been trained to believe and do.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Regna  sereno  intenso ed infinito！
Who did that?
Who broke the silence?!
The silent audience all turn their heads and stare at Sonetto.
Yet the apparition has gone.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry, Timekeeper, I just ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Get ready to run, Sonetto.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The Abraxases are coming.
TO BE CONTINUED…
